rubrics.justification: The description is largely consistent with the image and reported 3AB grade: prominent ICM, relatively looser/sparser TE, and acknowledgment of limited assessment from a single frame. Minor overreach exists in commenting on zona thinning/expanded status because the image appears somewhat collapsed/off-plane and not all features are clearly visible.

It integrates age, BMI, endometrial thickness, ovarian response, semen parameters, prior IVF history, lifestyle, and uncertainty around diagnosis, and explains how these modify prognosis alongside embryo quality.

The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with the implantation estimate tied to embryo grade, age, lining, and BMI. Slight limitation is that some prognostic ranges are broad and morphology-based estimates may be somewhat optimistic without acknowledging image ambiguity more strongly.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: reliance on Gardner grading, support for single embryo transfer at age 32, no bed rest, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Minor deviations include somewhat generalized ancillary testing suggestions and lifestyle comments that are reasonable but not core guideline-driven.

Provides clear next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including SET, luteal support adherence, lifestyle modifications, and workup thresholds after repeated failures.
